Reference image 1 is the approved seated-table game mockup: MATCH its softly sculpted 3D chibi characters, hair materials, blue ivory gold chair design, warm daylight and polished miniature anime rendering. NO table, floor, room, text, lines, numbers, shadows outside cells, or UI. Each character occupies its own central 80 percent of cell with comfortable transparent margins, never crossing into another cell. They are SITTING on the same pale ivory gold-trimmed blue upholstered chair, full head and seated knees visible; chibi 2.5-head proportions. Camera in each cell faces the seated character from a slightly elevated frontal three-quarter view, consistent framing/lighting. Important: both hands held naturally near the upper chest at 56 percent of cell height as if gripping a small fan of cards, BUT DO NOT DRAW ANY CARDS. Hands empty and close together so real variable-count cards can be layered there by the game. NO props, weapons, umbrellas, clocks, bombs, magic effects or pets. They smile or look playfully competitive. All faces recognizable. Keep hands at the same height in every sprite.
